notes: Removed every on/off checkbox from Date / Time, Weather, Shortcuts, Media and Computer that just repeated Content's own toggle for the same thing — Content is the one place to turn something on or off now.

Computer's four rows (volume/brightness/mic, power buttons, Bluetooth & Wi-Fi, power plan) and Media's "media player" row now show a real, live-styled preview of the actual widget instead of a bare checkbox and a sentence.

Fixed a bug from the last pass: removing the Weather/Shortcuts/Media checkboxes had also silently broken those tabs' own theme-capability check, since it was piggybacking on the now-gone checkbox lookup — their config sections could stop…
Moved Border out of its own collapsible section on Content and into the flat checklist itself, as one more row.
